newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end off on caution ahead of Fed decision.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end off on caution ahead of Fed decision.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Monday in low volume as investors sold stocks worried the U.S. Federal Reserve would raise interest rates making bonds more attractive than emerging market equities, brokers said. They added prices would probably dip in sluggish trade again Tuesday.

Monday, the General Index .IGRA fell 0.43 percent to 1,644.15 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL dropped 0.49 percent to 2,367.53 points. In a total of 1,139 trades, volume was a meager 21.8 million soles ($8.2 million), according to preliminary figures.
"The market will continue dipping because everybody is waiting" for the interest rates decision expected later this week, said Alex Balarin of local brokerage Macrovalores.

Among blue chip stocks, benchmark Telefonica del Peru "B" closed stable Monday at 5.88 soles in modest volume of 543,000 shares. Luz del Sur closed stable at 3.24 soles on volume of 311,000 shares. The electricity distributor announced Monday a dividend of 0.1153 soles per share from its 1996 profits. Backus y Johnston, the country's largest brewery, fell 2.0 percent to 2.45 soles in volume of 405,000 shares.
